name: plot-2d
title: 2D coordinate plane
description: SVG coordinate planes with grid, axes, arrows, lines and draggable handles for interactive widgets.

width.description: Default viewBox width of a plane in SVG units (a plane's own w overrides it). The svg still scales to its container.

arrowHead.description: Maximum arrow-head length in SVG units.

handleRadius.description: Radius of the visible dot drawn by P.handle().

hitRadius.description: Radius of the invisible touch target around each handle (keep it ≥ 16 for fingers).

colors.description: Up to four CSS colours for the classes c1…c4 in light mode. Empty = core tokens (term, bad, ok, warn-edge).

darkColors.description: Up to four CSS colours for c1…c4 in dark mode. Empty = same as "colors" (or the core tokens).

colorNames.description: Extra colour class names, each mapped to a palette slot 1–4, a core token name (e.g. "ink", "muted", "term") or a CSS colour: {"blue": 1, "grey": "muted"}. Lets existing markup keep its own class names.

markNames.description: Extra class names that draw like the package's shape classes, e.g. {"swept": "region", "latch": "hollow", "gate": "rod"}. A value lists one or more of: fill outline thin dash faint region hollow rod pin. Rules are written in the order given; give the colour with colorNames (colours are written after shapes, so a modifier listed later wins).
